subject: Request: temporary launch fuse & graceband — pricing and true-up
messages:
From: Amal Kapoor <amal@brightshop.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: launch next week — temporary rate fuse & graceband request

Ben —

We’ve got a hard launch scheduled next Monday (2026-07-20) for a new checkout flow. Predictive traffic models show a 3x spike for the first 48 hours and we’re worried about hitting our current QPS quota and throttle windows. Can Redwood provide a short-term throughput uplift (ideally 72 hours) and a capped overrun policy so we don’t get hit with a surprise bill during the launch?

Key asks: 
- Temporary increase to our quota to sustain the 3x peak for up to 72 hours
- A one-time graceband/cap on overrun charges (we’re asking for a cap of $4,000)
- Fast estimate of incremental cost so we can sign off with finance

We value predictable economics — if there’s a simple SOW or signable acknowledgement we can execute quickly, that would help. Attaching our expected call volume sheet (launch forecast).

Thanks,
Amal Kapoor
Head of Growth, BrightShop
amal@brightshop.com

Attachments: brightshop-launch-forecast.csv (attachment stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amal Kapoor <amal@brightshop.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: launch next week — temporary rate fuse & graceband request

Amal —

We can support a short-term uplift. Quick proposal so we can move fast: 

1) Launch fuse (temporary uplift): +150% quota for a 72-hour window starting at your chosen go-live time.
2) Overrun cap: Redwood will cap billed overrun exposure to $4,000 for that window.
3) Discount: 20% off our standard overrun rate for any consumption within the capped window.
4) Rollback: BrightShop agrees to revert to baseline quotas immediately after the 72-hour window; we’ll monitor and can auto-roll back earlier if traffic subsides.

I’ve attached a quick cost sketch (estimated-overrun-calculation.xlsx) based on the numbers you sent — this assumes the 3x scenario you noted and includes the 20% concession. If that looks ok I can route a one-page SOW for signature (we typically do a brief ack + SOW for these temporary windows).

Two notes: 
- We’ll require a start time and a contact on your side during the window for canary cutover / throttling decisions.
- We’ll need to lock in the timeframe and SOW by end of day Monday to have infra and finance approvals in place.

If you want a smaller cap or a different percent, say so and I’ll run finance.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
P: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: estimated-overrun-calculation.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T13:38:00-07:00
Subject: FW: BrightShop launch uplift — quick approval request

Team —

BrightShop asked for a 72-hour temporary uplift for next Monday (start TBD) to handle a 3x spike. Proposed terms I suggested to them: +150% quota for 72 hours, overrun cap $4,000, and 20% off standard overrun rate while in the window. They’ll sign a brief SOW/ack.

Questions for finance/ops: 
- Can we approve a hard cap of $4,000 on billed overrun exposure for a single window? (I want to avoid an open liability.)
- Is 20% concession on overrun rate OK for this customer size (expected uplift ~$11k gross before concession)?
- Operational check: can infra enable the temporary quota by Friday if we lock start time?

I’ve attached my calc (same file). If you’re good with these guardrails I’ll send the SOW and the sign link. If finance needs a different cap or discount, tell me what to offer — we want to keep this a 1-pager and avoid contract redlines.

Thanks,
—Ben

(On the numbers: baseline monthly spend $27k MRR; this is strategically important — they’re a target logo for the retail vertical. If we make the uplift a repeatable playbook we can standardize offering.)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amal Kapoor <amal@brightshop.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: launch next week — temporary rate fuse & graceband request

Amal —

Thanks for the heads up and the forecast. Finance and infra have signed off with two small clarifications and we’re ready to proceed. Final terms: 

• Temporary uplift: +150% quota for a 72-hour window beginning 2026-07-20 09:00 PT (you can confirm a different start time if needed).
• Overrun exposure cap: $4,000 total billed exposure for the 72-hour window.
• Discount: 20% off our standard overrun rate inside that window.
• Deliverable: one-page SOW to be signed by BrightShop and returned. I’ve attached the draft SOW (sow-temp-uplift-draft.pdf).

Operational next steps: 
1) Confirm start time and the on-call contact for the cutover (name + cell).
2) Sign the one-page SOW and return via DocuSign link below.
3) We’ll schedule a 30-min pre-launch call with infra (canary plan + rollback) the morning of the start.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/s/BRIGHT-3452/temporary-uplift (placeholder)
Pre-launch checklist drive folder: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/s/Launch-SOW-templates

If you sign by EOD Monday we’ll pre-provision capacity and run a smoke canary the night before. Happy to adjust the cap if BrightShop wants a lower number and compensating higher discount — open to discussion.

Best —
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: sow-temp-uplift-draft.pdf (attachment stub)
